scope: single public BaTiO3 P4mm COD 9014273, conditional q interpolation, synthetic only

data.q_parent_identity: one unique Sobol q draw per parent; split before nuisance/noise draws
data.input_transform: per-profile max normalization then log1p(100*x)/log(101), applied identically to every branch
data.truth_policy: q/eta/texture truth used only to generate spectra and post-hoc score; DONUT receives no truth labels in train/validation/model selection

donut.encoder: 1D convolutional encoder, no input skip path
donut.decoder: latent-only 1D convolutional decoder; output length matches input
donut.latent_scaling: explicit per-coordinate scale into frozen physical bounds
donut.validation_selection: minimum validation composite loss; ties select earliest epoch

experiment_3b.background: V9 fixed polynomial shape, random amplitude 0.005-0.008; inference background fixed 0.0065

experiment_3c.background: V9 fixed polynomial shape, random amplitude 0.005-0.008; inference background fixed 0.0065
experiment_3c.noise: Poisson counts plus Gaussian readout 0.5-1.5 counts

experiment_3d_texture.generator: hkl-aware March-Dollase preferred orientation in V9 generator
experiment_3d_texture.inference: zero-texture differentiable forward; generator-only texture OOD stress
experiment_3d_texture.training_policy: zero-shot transformation of the frozen texture-free 3c held-out inputs; no retraining
experiment_3d_texture.noise: Poisson counts plus Gaussian readout 0.5-1.5 counts

experiment_4.condition: same final no-texture noisy condition as experiment_3c

lbfgsb.objective: mean squared error in shared transformed profile domain

evaluation.test_policy: frozen test is read once after model/checkpoint selection; no tuning on test
evaluation.classic_solver: deterministic; report one result, not fabricated seeds
evaluation.latency: warm-up, CUDA sync around GPU timings; CPU and GPU forward/inference separately
